title: Certificate specification manifest
description: Machine-readable form of an intygsspecifikation. Authored from the specification document, reviewed against it by a human, and then enforced by CertificateSpecConformanceTest. Lives at app/src/test/resources/certificate-specs/<type>/v<major>_<minor>/spec.yaml.

recipient.description: Recipient id: FKASSA, TRANSP or SKR.

id.description: KAT_1, KAT_2, ... numbered in specification order.
The question number from the specification, used verbatim as the ElementId.

component.description: The Inputkomponent column, e.g. "SK-002 (kodverk)". Must be known to ComponentTypeMapping.

multiplicity.description: The Multiplicitet column, e.g. "0..1". Documentation only.

helpText.description: Hjälptext from the Hjälptexter section, copied word for word.

header.description: The "Rubrik:" prefix of a Rubriktext cell, when the cell has both a heading and a label.

parent.description: The element this one is nested under. Required for DFR rows.

xmlParent.description: Only when the XML structure differs from the question structure: the id an explicit ElementMapping must point at.

fieldId.description: The id from the XML-mappning column: TextId, BooleskId, KodId, DatumId, PeriodKodId, ...

options.description: The selectable codes, in the order they are displayed to the user — which is the order of the options column, not necessarily the order of the Urval bracket.

rules.description: The SR codes from the Regel column. Must be known to ComponentTypeMapping.

status.description: Only 'implemented' elements are checked by CertificateSpecConformanceTest. Flipped as the last step of the category increment that implements it.
